name: io.github.sferarc/keycloak-api-mcp
title: Keycloak Admin API
description: Unofficial: one tool per Keycloak admin operation on a realm, read-only unless writes are enabled

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the server, such as https://keycloak.example.com

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A fixed access token; otherwise set KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID and KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: A confidential client with a service account, for the client credentials grant

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_TOKEN_REALM
environmentVariables.description: Realm of that client, if not KEYCLOAK_REALM (for example master)

environmentVariables.name: KEYCLOAK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: 1 to list the tools that change data
